text:
julian: FYI we're planning a geo-aware v2 cutover this Thu in a 1h change window for EU and APAC. aiming to route traffic by region intent, not just IP. deploy-bot scheduled it for 18:00 UTC.
anna: what are the rollback thresholds?
julian: primary: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency increase > 150ms vs baseline. fallback policy: route EU -> v1 if triggered.
oliver: can we pin mobile SDKs to v1 automatically? some older clients lack the new header.
maria: yes — mobile team ok with a short TTL pin. recommend sending header x-client-prefer: v1 for those SDK versions.
julian: add to release notes and the rollout playbook: header-based pin + region routing + fallback to v1 cluster.
product-pm: confirm: no schema changes for v2 responses except optional metadata field new_model_info, safe for clients. we documented it in the spec.
anna: telemetry hooks to watch: tokens/sec, p50/p95, error_codes (500/502/504), model-fallback-count. any metric missing?
sre-bot: add heatmap for seq_len distribution — changes in input length can spike KV cache misses.
julian: good call. also watch cache hit ratio and batch sizes.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by julian at 2155128000. rolling 3-stage: canary 1% EU -> 10% EU -> full EU + APAC staged. notifications enabled.
oliver: Canary group list? are there internal test keys included?
julian: yes: internal-test, canary-partners, and a small random 1% bucket. please exclude mobile v1-only clients from canary.
maria: will prepare a fast rollback runbook and a short snippet to add to the SDK for header pinning. snippet: ```http
POST /v2/infer
Headers: {
  "x-client-version": "1.9.2",
  "x-client-prefer": "v1"
}
```
product-pm: update release notes draft and notify customer success for top 10 customers in EU/APAC.
anna: who's on pager during the window?
julian: oncall: oliver, backup: anna, escalations: sre lead. I'll be monitoring dashboards and release notes channel.
oliver: I'll be oncall and will bring up rollback if error threshold hit.
sre-bot: preflight checks: model variants compatibility OK, infra capacity >= 120% expected QPS, autoscale policies active. All green.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 1% EU COMPLETE - 0 errors in 15m, p50 delta +12ms. proceeding to 10% in 10m.
maria: prepping a client-side hotfix branch in case header injection needed quickly.
anna: remind marketing to avoid naming this "breaking v2" in public comms. it's backward-compatible.
product-pm: noted. will word it as "performance & routing improvements in v2".
deploy-bot: Canary 10% EU COMPLETE - errors 0.2% (below threshold). p50 +40ms. advancing to full EU per plan.
julian: hold full APAC until we confirm KV cache hit stabilizes post-EU ramp.
oliver: ACK. will watch cache hit ratio.
sre-bot: KV cache hit ratio trending: 92% -> 78% during EU ramp, likely due to different client seq_len. investigating.
maria: rolling back APAC ramp until cache stabilizes. pausing final stage.
julian: decision: pause APAC, keep EU rolled to 100%, open incident channel if regressions. draft rollback triggers posted in runbook.
product-pm: updated release notes with EU-only rollout and APAC pause.
anna: thanks all — we'll reconvene in 30m to decide APAC approach.
